a.lede: Under Apple’s new policy, the company will scan publicly shared iCloud links for harmful content – and possibly ban violators.
a.title: Apple will monitor your public iCloud links now, starting with iOS 27.3

b.lede: Content shared with anyone who has the URL will be scanned for 'harmful content,' though the iMaker hasn't defined that term
b.title: Apple turns iCloud into spy cloud, will start looking at public share links
